description: Generic physical resource trips and <=3-cell face-to-face contacts. New playable worlds enable it; old saves without this profile remain on historical contact semantics.

semantics.travel: At most stepsPerTick cardinal non-river cells per 8-hour activity tick, with fords at fixed y rows. Trips start from a resident's household, find a reachable real resource site by bounded BFS, spend actual work/leisure ticks away, then return with physically collected resources.
semantics.contact: Same-tick sampled positions of actual individuals must be within contactRadius cells. ContactLog records both IDs, snapshot affiliations, residential settlements, distance and actual encounter coordinate; one pair at most once per simulated day.
semantics.religion: Shared encounters provide the provenance for local sermons and cross-settlement faith/oracle evidence. Ordinary preaching still cannot weaken a 40+ rival. Counter/oracle outcome gates remain separate.
semantics.persistence: Restore of historical saves with no mobility field defaults to disabled. ContactLog is a capped short-lived cache and movementTrace is never saved. No auto-teleporting followers, forced conversions, or extra food.
